why: Gift shops and stationery stores need gift wrap, personalisation engraving and event management. Different from regular retail: the focus is on customisation and occasion-based selling.
operator: The gift and stationery shop owner manages a curated inventory of wrapping paper, greeting cards, engravable items and event souvenirs. Their day is custom orders, gift packing and personalisation requests.
entities: Shop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Product (id, shopId, sku, nameAr, nameEn, category, unitPricePiasters, costPiasters, taxRate, isPersonalisable, personalisationNotes, condition, status, locationShelf)
Customer (id, shopId, name, phone, whatsAppOptIn, purchaseHistoryCount, totalSpentPiasters, notes)
Order (id, shopId, customerId, lines, totalsPiasters, discountPiasters, serviceChargePiasters, paymentMethod, status, createdAt, closedAt)
OrderLine (id, orderId, productId, quantity, unitPricePiasters, personalisationDetails, note)
Staff (id, shopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: No : stationery shop carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Products have condition states not expiry dates
special: The core structures are the personalisable product flag, the order with personalisation details and the gift-wrap selection. Personalisation is the key differentiator from regular retail.
screens: Product catalogue: grid of items with name, price, condition, personalisable badge
Product detail: full item info, personalisation options, engraving text preview
Gift wrap selector: wrapping paper, ribbon, card options, preview of packaged item
Customer profile: purchase history, total spent, notes, opt-in status
Order creation: add items, select gift wrap, add personalisation, apply discount, tender payment
Cash register: scan items, apply gift wrap, tender payment, print receipt with gift note
Staff shift: clock in/out, customer load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : inventory, pricing, reports, billing
Cashier: scan items, apply gift wrap, tender payment, print receipt
Stock clerk: receive shipments, update stock, relocate products
Assistant: personalisation orders, special gift requests
reports: Sales by day and hour: revenue per period, peak hours
Personalisation volume: number of items with engraving per period, revenue from personalisation
Customer lifetime value: total spent, visit frequency, average ticket
Order average: items per order, gift wrap rate, personalisation rate
Inventory aging: how long items have been in stock by category
integrations: Barcode scanner for SKU entry at till
Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and gift notes
WhatsApp deep link for customer notifications (ready order, personalisation complete)
Email for invoice and special order updates (opt-in)
onboarding: Shop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial inventory: the starting product list with names, prices and personalisable flag
Product categories: wrapping paper, greeting cards, engravable items, event souvenirs
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: receive first shipment, list first products, first customer sale with personalisation
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the personalisable product flag and role templates.

tasks.title: Add product catalogue with personalisable flag
tasks.brief: Build the product catalogue: grid of items with name, price, condition, personalisable badge. Done when the catalogue loads and displays items with personalisable badge correctly.
tasks.done: When product catalogue displays live data with personalisable badges

tasks.title: Add gift wrap selector with preview
tasks.brief: Build the gift wrap screen: wrapping paper, ribbon, card options, preview of packaged item. Done when the selector saves the wrap choice per order and displays the preview.
tasks.done: When gift wrap selector works and saves choice per order

tasks.title: Add personalisation text preview
tasks.brief: Build the personalisation screen: engraving text input, real-time preview on the product item. Done when the text is saved and preview updates instantly.
tasks.done: When personalisation text preview works end-to-end

tasks.title: Add customer profile with purchase history
tasks.brief: Build the customer profile screen: purchase history, total spent, notes, opt-in status. Done when the profile saves and displays customer data correctly.
tasks.done: When customer profile works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add order creation with gift wrap and personalisation
tasks.brief: Build the order screen: add items, select gift wrap, add personalisation, apply discount, tender payment. Done when the order saves all fields and the receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When order creation works end-to-end with gift wrap and personalisation

tasks.title: Add cash register with gift wrap and scanning
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan items, apply gift wrap, tender payment, print receipt with gift note. Done when the sale records all fields and receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end and receipt prints with gift note

tasks.title: Add customer LTV report
tasks.brief: Build the LTV report: total spent, visit frequency, average ticket per customer. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When LTV report pulls live data and displays correctly

tasks.title: Add order average report (items, gift wrap, personalisation rates)
tasks.brief: Build the report showing items per order, gift wrap rate, personalisation rate per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct rates.
tasks.done: When order average report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add inventory aging report by category
tasks.brief: Build the aging report: items in stock by category and how long. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct aging buckets.
tasks.done: When inventory aging report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial gift shop setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: shop basics, initial inventory, product categories with personalisable flag, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the shop appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and shop is created

risks: No special-category data risks (retail sales model)
Encryption key loss makes product records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Personalisation text that violates consumer protection or contains disallowed content
